description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
